tools.name: citerank_analyze_url
tools.description: Run a full AI visibility audit on any public URL. Returns schema analysis, AI citation score, E-E-A-T signals, agentic readiness, and prioritized issues with specific fixes.

tools.name: citerank_check_brand_citations
tools.description: Check whether a brand/domain is cited in AI-generated answers (Google AI Overviews, Gemini). Returns citation rate, share of voice, top cited queries, and competitor sources.

tools.name: citerank_generate_schema
tools.description: Generate production-ready JSON-LD structured data for any URL. Analyzes page content and produces schema markup ready to implement.

tools.name: citerank_check_agentic_readiness
tools.description: Check how ready a website is for AI agent interactions. Tests for MCP endpoint, WebMCP declarative tools, potentialAction schema, A2A agent card, llms.txt, pricing.md, and more.

tools.name: citerank_simulate_agent_journey
tools.description: Simulate an AI agent attempting to complete a task on a website (book, quote, contact, buy, subscribe). Returns step-by-step results and specific fixes for each failure point.

tools.name: citerank_list_wp_pages
tools.description: List all pages and posts on your connected WordPress site with their current schema deployment status. Returns each page with its URL, post type, word count, and whether schema has been deployed.

tools.name: citerank_analyze_wp_page
tools.description: Analyze a specific page on your connected WordPress site. Returns the recommended schema type with confidence + reason, extracted signals (phone, address, price, FAQ pairs, WooCommerce data), author info, and full content for schema generation.

tools.name: citerank_deploy_schema
tools.description: Deploy JSON-LD schema markup directly to a specific page on your connected WordPress site. The schema is injected into the page head and tracked in the deployment log. Supports schema, speakable, llms_txt, robots, entity, webmcp, and a2a deployment types.

tools.name: citerank_get_wp_health
tools.description: Check the health of all deployments on your connected WordPress site. Returns post-level schema status (active/missing/modified/deleted) and file-level checks for llms.txt, a2a.json, toolcatalog.json, and robots.txt rules.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: citerank_list_wp_pages, citerank_get_wp_health · Private data: citerank_simulate_agent_journey, citerank_get_wp_health · Public sink: citerank_check_brand_citations, citerank_list_wp_pages, citerank_get_wp_health · Destructive: citerank_analyze_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: citerank_list_wp_pages, citerank_get_wp_health · Private data: citerank_simulate_agent_journey, citerank_get_wp_health · Public sink: citerank_check_brand_citations, citerank_list_wp_pages, citerank_get_wp_health · Destructive: citerank_analyze_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
